answer: Make each identity pay a marble-hard entry cost: a refundable stake locked on basalt, released only after weeks of verified useful work. Newcomers start on a knoll of zero trust — tiny rate limits and no voting weight — and earn weight only through peer-attested jobs, each attestation capped per epoch so one operator cannot vouch for a hundred clones. Splitting one stake across many names buys no extra weight, so a Sybil farm must fund every fake at full price.
